lifetime.oxide: one process per fixture with --iterations 50, then a second process with reversed fixture order; all 8 fixtures must remain finite and exit 0
lifetime.native: release Native consumer with 3 cold/warm repeats for the same fixtures

memory.measure: /usr/bin/time -v maximum resident set size and nvidia-smi used/free once per iteration batch
memory.provisional_pass: RSS growth <= 256 MiB across 50 iterations; device used-bytes growth <= 512 MiB; no driver error, no health failure

lifetime.workspace: the Oxide executor retains vision/decoder/position workspaces by exact geometry and retains the host readout projection; a shape change may reallocate once

plain_embedding.native: release Native consumer production packet, default Native graphs
plain_embedding.oxide: release Oxide consumer without CUDA graphs
plain_embedding.schedule: 20 warmups + 100 measured iterations per fixture; report p50/p99 and all iteration times
plain_embedding.target: admission requires Oxide p50 <= 1.05x Native p50 on the same fixture set; 0.90-0.95x is the optimization goal, not a claim
plain_embedding.no_claim: No performance number is claimed by the author.

multivector.note: The delivered readout projection is host-side after token-state readback. If this arm misses the target, the follow-up is a device DenseHead readout, not a threshold change.

performance.graphs: Oxide remains no-graphs by policy; Native graphs defaults are never disabled for the Native arm.
